findings.text: non-blocking: the head-run block quotes "# revision: 228f17c182" and "18 passed in 8.12s" while the manifest's after_suite arm and logs/head-arm.log record d161d8d837 and "18 passed in 8.51s", so the landed evidence carries two unlabelled head measurements and a reader cannot tell which run the after_suite citation refers to.

non-blocking: the gate log's header names revision, tree, module and cwd but not the SLURM_JOB_ID state, so the node's done_when ("as a job on all_debug with SLURM_JOB_ID unset") is satisfied only in its "passes in full" half and the named environment is never shown.

non-blocking: the cause-2 verdict states that record["picker_selection"] raised KeyError, but cause 1 masks it in the recorded base arm, whose five reds are all JSONDecodeError at the helper, so the second defect's reproduction is inferred rather than shown red at the base.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from ee93819a0d to d161d8d837; 228f17c182 rewrites the invoke helper and the deterministic-route wait in tests/test_routing_picker_key.py (12 added, 4 deleted) and d161d8d837 adds the 50-line landing fragment, with no product file touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for a full pass at head as a job on all_debug with SLURM_JOB_ID unset; logs/head-arm.log:1-4 name the revision, tree and command and its last line is EXIT=0, but no line records whether SLURM_JOB_ID was unset, so the environment the measure names is unrecorded.
item_verdicts.goal: the source node's goal is "Make tests/test_routing_picker_key.py pass in full on the primary branch"; commit 228f17c182 changes only tests/test_routing_picker_key.py and logs/head-arm.log records "18 passed" EXIT=0 at head d161d8d837.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the reviewed run directory; it carries status complete, both arms as JSON with log paths, the two cause verdicts, a landing line, and the figure-free declaration the small-node rule requires.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source node was fenced to reckon, tests, docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround, that directory's qwnw-red-file-routing-picker-key.html and docs/figures/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/qwnw-red-file-routing-picker-key; both paths in the diff lie inside that grant.

justifications.durability: tests/test_routing_picker_key.py:106-114 reddens if dispatch stops recording picker_selection, which the base arm's five JSONDecodeError ids at logs/base-arm.log show already fires on the reverted helper.
justifications.evidence: logs/base-arm.log ends "5 failed, 13 passed" EXIT=1 and logs/head-arm.log ends "18 passed" EXIT=0, but neither header records the SLURM_JOB_ID state the done_when names and the fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/qwnw-red-file-routing-picker-key.html:43-47 quotes a different head run than the after_suite arm.
justifications.fit: the added import at tests/test_routing_picker_key.py:16 uses the module-alias form the file already uses for dispatch_plan_module and picker, and the comment style matches the surrounding explanatory comments.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_routing_picker_key.py:61 decodes result.stdout and tests/test_routing_picker_key.py:106 reads the picker answer through crew_runs.dispatch_field, and logs/head-arm.log closes EXIT=0 at d161d8d837 with 18 passed.
justifications.reuse: the diff adds no definition; it reuses reckon/crew/runs.py:242 dispatch_field, the accessor that already answers a dispatch-time detail field for either pointer shape, rather than re-implementing the two-shape read inline.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches only the two files named in the manifest, both inside the declared write paths, at 62 added and 4 deleted lines for a small node.
